summary: Implemented inventaris UX without new tables: PATCH status endpoint with validation, room audit mode (Inertia + localStorage checklist/progress), catalog stats strip + one-tap status selects on cards, mobile quick actions on show (status/ticket/label/edit), and ticket create prefill via asset_no_inventaris query.
